title: Outer-horn restriction on equivalence-edge components of a Segal space
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, Kan complexes, homotopy fibers and weak homotopy equivalences from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the Kan model structure of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper], and the Reedy model structure of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure]. A simplicial space is a functor $V:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{sSet}$. It is a Segal space if it is Reedy fibrant and its consecutive-edge maps $V_n\to V_1\times_{V_0}\cdots\times_{V_0}V_1$ are weak homotopy equivalences for every $n\geq2$. For vertices $x,y$ of $V_0$, let $M_V(x,y)$ be the strict fiber of $(d_1,d_0):V_1\to V_0^2$. The homotopy category $hV$ has those vertices as objects, morphisms $\pi_0M_V(x,y)$, identity from $s_0$, and composition from the degree-two Segal map and $d_1$. Let $V_{\mathrm{eq}}\subseteq V_1$ be the union of components representing isomorphisms in $hV$.

For $n\geq0$ let $F(n)_k=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta([k],[n])$, discrete in the inner direction. Let $cK$ denote the constant simplicial space on a simplicial set $K$. For a small simplicial space $X$, define the simplicial mapping space by
$$\operatorname{Map}(X,V)_q=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sS}}(X\times c\Delta^q,V),$$
with simplicial operators given by precomposition. Define $T_V(X)\subseteq\operatorname{Map}(X,V)$ to be the intersection of the inverse images of $V_{\mathrm{eq}}\subseteq V_1=\operatorname{Map}(F(1),V)$ under restriction along every map $F(1)\to X$. Thus a simplex belongs to $T_V(X)$ exactly when all its edge evaluations belong to $V_{\mathrm{eq}}$.

For an integer $k\geq2$, let $H(k)\subseteq F(k)$ be the union of the faces $d^iF(k-1)$ for $1\leq i\leq k$; equivalently, in outer degree $m$ it consists of those monotone maps $[m]\to[k]$ whose image omits at least one vertex other than $0$. For every Segal space $V$ and every $k\geq2$, restriction induces a weak homotopy equivalence
$$T_V(F(k))\longrightarrow T_V(H(k)).$$
